Hi Elena / Mike —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get moving. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) tailored to SkyThera's production launch window. The document embeds a phased implementation plan covering: rollout waves, canary gating, data migration approach, and the training schedule for ops and support teams. I also attached a brief Evaluation Plan (EvalPlan_Teams.pdf) with the acceptance criteria we propose for the canary and final cutover.

Key asks from us this week:
- Confirm the preferred canary region (us-west-2 vs us-east-1) and the preferred 2-week window for the initial 5% traffic slice.
- Confirm the availability of your infra/ops leads for a 60-minute kickoff on Monday so we can agree SLAs, oncall, and rollback criteria.
- Share any internal blackout dates in July — we should schedule the training and migration around those.

High-level MAP milestones (dates are provisional):
- Week 0 (this week): Finalize MAP & Eval criteria
- Week 1–2: Canary build + dry-run (5% traffic) + acceptance eval
- Week 3–4: Gradual ramp to 50% + migration of historical keys
- Week 5: Full cutover and 2-week hypercare

Attachments: SkyThera_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with roles & owners), EvalPlan_Teams.pdf (acceptance criteria)

I'll be working with Priyom (technical lead) and Vivek (customer success) on the operations side — looping them in so ownership is clear.

Quick note on costs: the MAP includes recommended batching/kv-cache settings for initial canary to keep per-token costs predictable; we'll surface a cost delta after the dry-run.

Next steps: please reply with region preference and two available windows for the Monday kickoff.

Thanks,

- Blackout: July 20–22 is a company all-hands; avoid those days for cutover.
- Kickoff: Monday works — could we do 11:00–12:00 ET? I'll invite our infra lead, Mike, and our SecOps lead if needed.

Elena — great notes. Responses inline and a slightly revised MAP summary below.

- Region & isolation: us-east-1 is fine. We can provision a dedicated VPC endpoint for the canary pool and enforce network policies. Priyom will share the peering / security checklist.
- Blackout: noted (July 20–22) — we will not schedule cutover activities that week.
- Canary traffic: agree on shadowed live traffic with strict throttling. Proposed approach: run shadow traffic for 48 hours in parallel to validate inference parity, then flip a controlled 5% live slice for 72 hours with autoscale disabled and manual approval before ramp. Eval plan includes: latency percentile checks (p95/p99), error rates, and semantic regression thresholds on a holdout prompt set.

Revised MAP summary (owners indicated):
- Action: Provision canary pool (us-east-1) — Owner: Priyom — Due: 2026-07-08
- Action: Network & VPC peering config — Owner: SkyThera infra (Mike) + Priyom — Due: 2026-07-09
- Action: Run shadow 48-hour validation — Owner: Marissa / Vivek — Due: 2026-07-12
- Action: 5% live canary (72 hours) + Eval — Owner: Priyom — Due: 2026-07-15
- Action: Ramp to 50% (staged) — Owner: SkyThera + Redwood ops — Due: 2026-07-22 (avoid company blackout day)
- Action: Final cutover & hypercare — Owner: Marissa / Vivek — Due: 2026-08-05

I've added a short note to the HubSpot deal with these milestones — link below. Priyom, can you draft the canary checklist and attach to the MAP? Vivek, please confirm training slots for the support rotation (we'll need two 90-minute sessions).

Subject: Re: Project MAP & phased rollout proposal — SkyThera (post-signature)

Marissa / Elena — attaching a concise canary checklist (canary-checklist.md) and calling out a few technical constraints here so expectations are aligned: 

Technical canary checklist highlights:
1) Provision dedicated canary pool (2x A100 or matched instance types) with KV-cache enabled.
2) Configure VPC endpoint and restrict to SkyThera CIDR ranges — Redwood will provide the peering config and a Terraform snippet.
3) Shadow validation: run identical request set (production anonymized sample) with response diffing. Thresholds: semantic drift <= 2% (per eval set), p95 latency < 350ms, errors < 0.1%.
4) Live 5% slice: set request caps per-minute and a circuit breaker (fail-open to previous model variant). Manual approval required for any ramp beyond 5%.
5) Logging & retention: increase trace sampling to 100% for the canary; logs stored for 30 days for regression debugging.

Dependencies & blockers:
- SkyThera to provide peering IPs and confirm firewall opening.
- SecOps approval for shadow traffic — if required we can run a red-team review but that will add 3–4 days.

I'll push the checklist to the shared Drive and attach the markdown to the MAP. If everyone agrees the plan above, I can start provisioning on 7/8.

--
Priyom Das
Technical Program Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
